inputs.text: [serious] Carnivore. [confident] And it led a double life: it hunted just as well on foot as it did up in the sky.
[curious] On foot? [gasps] A flying animal that walks?
[confident] Yes, on all four legs. [slowly] And scientists think that on the ground, it moved at about 7 miles an hour — [amazed] as fast as a kid running.
[curious] What did it eat, on its island?
[warmly] Tiny dwarf dinosaurs, [confident] miniature cousins of the long-necked giants. On that island, almost everything had shrunk.
